name: Full-period (no partial proration)

Data sweep: ProductSellingModel SellingModelType='Evergreen' = 4 PSMs (Monthly/Quarterly/Semi-Annual/Yearly) but Evergreen QLIs=0, Evergreen OrderItems=0, Evergreen PSMO=0, Evergreen PBE=0, PBE children of the 4 Evergreen PSMs=0 (unpriceable). proposedFix: Not a defect - no fix to V21. To make this scenario testable, the org would need an Evergreen product wired end-to-end: a Product2 with a ProductSellingModelOption to one of the 4 existing Evergreen PSMs plus an active PBE (non-zero list, Fortra Price Book, USD) under that PSM, then a UI-priced (not headless Apex-inserted) Evergreen quote line with AllowPartialProrationPeriods=false. That is org-config + UI-data creation outside this validation's scope (and a headless Apex line would net $0 via the documented hydration gap, yielding no assertable number). Recommend deferring I-07 until Evergreen catalog is seeded, or descope as not-applicable to current FortraUAT catalog.
notes: Active proc V21 confirmed (ESDV 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY, context SalesTransactionContextExt_v2 v23). Gating trace is internally consistent and matches the catalog proc_mechanism exactly: ListOperation91 is the AllowPartialProrationPeriods=false OR itemTransientEndDate IsNull full-period filter; StartProrationPeriod is consumed by the partial-path Proration BKM (step 99 inputs StartProrationPeriod/Day/Month), not by the full-period Assignment. The four V21 proration buckets partition cleanly by SellingModelType: ListOperation87 (neither Evergreen nor TermDefined -> Assignment OneTimePricingTermCountConstant=0, B-08's path), ListOperation83 (Evergreen partial -> fractional Proration BKM), ListOperation91 (Evergreen full-period -> Assignment EvergreenPricingTermCountConstant=1, THIS scenario), ListOperation94 (TermDefined OR Evergreen -> SubscriptionPricing95). Sibling I-01/I-02 (P0 PASS) exercise the TermDefined proration writer (skeleton steps 121-123) and PricingTermCount=1/EndDate carry on convert; they do NOT touch the Evergreen full-period branch (TermDefined != Evergreen, so they never enter ListContainer90). Per METHOD_BRIEF anti-phantom-defect + known-harness-artifact doctrine, a scenario whose only possible evidence is static metadata + a $0 headless fixture is BLOCKED, not PASS/FAIL. Root cause = TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT (org never seeded any Evergreen product), NOT a V21 procedure or org-pricing-config defect (the proc branch itself is correct). defect_provenance=none/catalog-derived; no ticket.
verdict_reason: The full-period branch (ListOperation91 -> Assignment92 stamping PricingTermCount=EvergreenPricingTermCountConstant=1) is present and correctly structured in live V21, but FortraUAT has zero Evergreen products/PSMOs/PBEs/lines (0 Evergreen QLIs vs 938,923 TermDefined), so the SellingModelType=Evergreen gate cannot fire on any real or UI-buildable record and the preflight 'priceable Evergreen seed' cannot pass - BLOCKED on missing test data, not a defect.
